share.title: Share the board
share.intro: Anyone opening the link sees the full-screen animation, phones included. The link holds a copy of the board: later edits do not change it.
share.hint: {{size}} KB link, no server: the data travels in the address.
share.invalid: This share link is invalid or incomplete.
share.shortWithTalk: Create short link with Team Talk
share.loginForShort: Sign in (Settings → Account) to create short links.
share.talkNeedsCloud: The Team Talk stays on this device: the link only holds the board. Use the MP4 export to share the voice too.

settings.title: Settings
settings.bridgeHint: The app connects to {{url}} where diagonale-mcp --live runs: changes made from Claude Desktop or Claude Code show up here in real time.

account.title: Account
account.why: Sign in to sync boards across devices and create short links (with Team Talk too). Without an account everything works locally.
account.checkEmail: Check your inbox: we sent you a sign-in link.
